title: Erasure Coding
description: Protects data with parity fragments - any k of n fragments rebuild the data - using far less overhead than full replication. Erasure coding is how cold storage stays cheap and safe.

title: Scrubbing
description: Reads all data periodically verifying checksums, finding bit-rot before it accumulates beyond repair. Scrubbing is the immune patrol that keeps pools healthy.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Disk Failure Prediction
description: Predicts disk failures from SMART data and error trends, replacing drives before they die. Prediction turns failures into planned maintenance.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Hot-Spare Rebuild
description: Keeps hot spare disks ready and starts rebuilding onto them the moment a failure is detected - no waiting for a human. Automatic rebuild minimizes the vulnerable degraded window.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Pool Expansion
description: Adds disks or nodes to the pool online, restriping data automatically with no downtime. Expansion keeps up with growth without forklift migrations.

title: Tiering
description: Moves data between fast and cheap tiers by access pattern - hot on SSD, cold on disk - automatically. Tiering buys performance where it matters and savings everywhere else.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Deduplication
description: Stores duplicate blocks once, referencing them many times - massive savings for VM images and backups. Dedup trades CPU and RAM for disk.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Snapshot Schedules
description: Takes copy-on-write snapshots on a schedule - hourly, daily, weekly - giving restore points at every granularity. Schedules automate the discipline humans forget.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Checksum Trees
description: Verifies data with Merkle trees from blocks to pool root, pinpointing corruption precisely. Trees make integrity verification logarithmic instead of linear.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Rebuild Prioritization
description: Rebuilds the most critical data first - metadata, hot data - so the pool regains safety fastest where it counts. Prioritization shrinks the risk window intelligently.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Capacity Alerts
description: Alerts on capacity with forecasts - 'full in 30 days at current growth' - in time to act. Alerts with lead time prevent the 2 AM full-disk page.

title: Pool Balancing
description: Balances data and load across pool members, preventing hot disks and stranded capacity. Balancing keeps every spindle pulling its weight.

title: ZFS-Style Self-Healing
description: Detects checksum failures on read and heals from redundant copies automatically - the defining feature of self-healing filesystems. Every read verifies; every error repairs.

title: Failure Domains
description: Spreads redundancy across failure domains - racks, power, network - so one disaster cannot take all copies. Domains bound the blast radius of every failure mode.
